about.text: Cow's milk cheese originally from the Chanco farm in Maule Region. Now it is produced all over south-central Chile, and represents almost 50% of Chilean cheese consumption.

sources.text: Chile's Gouda-like semi-hard cow cheese from the Maule region; Wikipedia gives no ripening time
Chile's Gouda-like semi-hard cow cheese from the Maule region; Wikipedia gives no ripening time

facts.v: Pasteurised cow's milk; semi-soft with many small eyes and a thin, dry rind; ripened no more than 21 days (Spanish article)
Mostly industrial now; one of the most sold cheeses in Chile, after gouda-type cheeses (Spanish article)
